Name: artist_tool
Description: Tools for artists: Object Placer (click to place assets on surfaces), Path Placer (objects and fences along a curve), Road (meshes, decals and bent meshes along a curve), Wires (wires hanging between poles), Measure (distances and angles), Unpack Clutter (clutters into regular nodes), Texture Baker (albedo, roughness and normal from a high-poly model to a low-poly one), Physics Drop (objects fall and settle under physics that is there only while placing: drop the selected ones, pour with a brush, drag). By zloy_pingvin - https://t.me/zloytux
